# `deploy` — `/api/deploy`

Deploy / Publish router — SSH/SFTP file management for remote web servers. Handles IPv4 and IPv6 targets.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/deploy/targets`](#get-api-deploy-targets) | List all SFTP deployment targets; passwords are masked. |
| POST | [`/api/deploy/targets`](#post-api-deploy-targets) | Create a new SFTP deployment target and return its id. |
| PATCH | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}`](#patch-api-deploy-targets-tid) | Update a target; skips password if the masked placeholder is sent. |
| DELETE | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}`](#delete-api-deploy-targets-tid) | Remove a deployment target from the database. |
| GET | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}/browse`](#get-api-deploy-targets-tid-browse) | List directory contents at the given remote path. |
| DELETE | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}/file`](#delete-api-deploy-targets-tid-file) | Remove a single file from the remote server. |
| POST | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}/mkdir`](#post-api-deploy-targets-tid-mkdir) | Create a new directory on the remote server. |
| POST | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}/publish-page`](#post-api-deploy-targets-tid-publish-page) | Render a styled HTML page and upload it via SFTP. |
| POST | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}/test`](#post-api-deploy-targets-tid-test) | Verify SSH/SFTP connectivity and list file count in web_root. |
| POST | [`/api/deploy/targets/{tid}/upload`](#post-api-deploy-targets-tid-upload) | Upload a file to the remote server via SFTP. |
